clips.title: The story
paras: Steam wails through the bluffs above Lushwater Oasis, where the Wailing Caverns twist beneath the Barrens. Naralex, a night elf druid, entered the springs hoping to restore life to the arid plains, but mutations and agitated wildlife now haunt the caverns.
